_comment: SCAFFOLD — Panda brand wiring the agent reads alongside skills/meta/higgsfield-mcp-bridge.md. Fill in the real Higgsfield element/character ids. Keys/secrets do NOT go here — env only.

brand.name: Panda Mobile
brand.notes: See memory: panda-mobile-brand-assets for exact logo/mascot paths, fonts.

character_references._note: Local hero turnaround sheets (multi-view) used as the master references for character consistency across stills/clips. 6336x2688 RGB.

pair_scale_lock._note: Binding composition lock measured from the approved panda/customer frame supplied by the user. Applies whenever both characters share a frame.
pair_scale_lock.ground_plane: Both characters' feet rest on the same ground line; do not fake the ratio with foreground/background depth.
pair_scale_lock.vertical_alignment: Panda ear-top aligns around the standing customer's lower chest / upper abdomen.
pair_scale_lock.human_posture: Upright relaxed stance, level shoulders, natural head-to-body proportion, feet planted.
pair_scale_lock.panda_posture: Upright bipedal mascot stance, broad rounded torso, short planted legs, canonical head-to-body proportion.
pair_scale_lock.motion_rule: Preserve the approved still's relative scale, body proportions, posture, and shared ground plane through every frame; no growth, shrinkage, depth drift, crouch, or camera move that changes apparent ratio.

higgsfield._note: Reference Element ids keep the panda + customer consistent across stills and clips. These are the LOCKED brand elements (created on Higgsfield from the turnaround sheets above). Confirm live via MCP show_reference_elements. Use the panda element for every panda shot, the customer element for the customer. Attach as MCP media / image_references — NEVER put the UUID in the prompt sentence (draws the turnaround sheet). Do not use student_ugc_element_id (TODO).
higgsfield.student_ugc_element_id: TODO — reusable id noted in memory panda-airport-arrival-ugc

phrase_aliases._note: Any of these words in brief/idea/script/scene_plan/prompts MUST resolve to the locked Element above — never invent a new character. Full protocol: skills/meta/higgsfield-mcp-bridge.md CHARACTER LOCK.

voices._note: PRODUCTION narration = ElevenLabs. Requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or an ElevenLabs MCP) on the box; without it the agent falls back to Higgsfield seed_audio (a generic preset — NOT the brand voice). The launcher interpolates a VOICE CAST map of all three speakers for the job language into every ElevenLabs leg. `options.narrator` is the DEFAULT speaker for script sections that omit `speaker`; section.speaker picks customer|panda|narrator per line (multi-voice shots allowed). Note the naming overlap: the job option is called `narrator` and its VALUE names the speaker, so an off-screen voice-over default is `options.narrator = "narrator"`. Explicit `options.voice_id` overrides the whole cast.
